verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is Ashby's claim of 250+ integrations that include job boards. That suggests some job-board distribution exists, but the pack never shows one posting fanning out or names any specific board. The public job posting API and job-posting webhooks support custom careers pages and integrations, not managed multi-board distribution. Missing for 10: named LinkedIn/Indeed/aggregator integrations, one-click multi-board fan-out workflow, sponsored-post budget/management inside the ATS, independent or hands-on corroboration.
